The first gold arrived at the U.S. Bullion Depository in Fort Knox, Kentucky, in January 1937, shipped by U.S. Mail. After that, the rule was strict: no visitors.

Today the Mint reports about 147.3 million ounces at Fort Knox, still valued on the books at $42.22 an ounce.

​
